facts.material: famotidine (H2 receptor antagonist) in oral suspension, 40 mg/5 mL
facts.function: treats duodenal/gastric ulcer, GERD, esophagitis, Zollinger-Ellison
facts.form: liquid oral suspension in dosage form

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3004 medicaments of mixed/unmixed products put up in measured doses or retail forms; chapter 30 note 1 exclusions do not apply; section VI note 2 confirms 3004
GRI 6: 3004.90 other; 3004.90.92 other; statistical line for medicaments primarily affecting the digestive system containing famotidine

rejected_alternatives.reason: bulk heterocyclic compound; product is a finished dosage-form medicament of 3004
imported in dosage form, not bulk unmeasured medicament

classification.rationale: Famotidine oral suspension is a dosage-form medicament of heading 3004; the HTS has a specific statistical line for digestive-system medicaments containing famotidine. N339838 (famotidine injection) used the same provision; its older-format suffix maps to the current .54 line.
